title: Blow-ups of minimizing cycles of ℝ^P are minimizing cycles of ℝ^P with rescaled weight (parent step 4(d), with (F1) and (F2))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, let S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn S univ) with ∂S = 0 (BoundaryVanishes S), and let R be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n) representing S. Let y ∈ ℝ^P and t > 0. Then there are S' ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and an IMRep R' in ℝ^P such that S' is minimizing in ℝ^P, ∂S' = 0, R' represents S', and R'.measure = ofReal(t^{−n})•R.measure.map(dilation y t), i.e. μ_{S'} = (μ_S)^{y,t}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (y : Euclid P) (t : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → 0 < t → IsMinimizingIn S univ → BoundaryVanishes S → R.Represents S → ∃ (S' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsMinimizingIn S' univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes S' ∧ R'.Represents S' ∧ R'.measure = ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n) • R.measure.map (dilation y t)
